resources.string: Wake only while any selected paired device is connected. Applies to notifications, repeat reminders, and Night Glow.
Off · Bluetooth does not restrict wakes.
Nearby devices permission is missing or revoked · wakes blocked. Allow it in app settings or turn this rule off.
Selected device connected · Bluetooth allows wakes.
No selected paired connection detected · wakes blocked.

Already-connected audio devices and BLE connections are checked when monitoring starts. Other device types may only be detected after reconnecting while this rule is on. Android cannot expose every connection; undetected devices block wakes. Pair devices in Bluetooth settings. Selections restored from a backup must still be paired here.
No paired devices. Pair a device in Bluetooth settings.
No longer paired · does not allow wakes
